title: The Pine Ridge
tagline: The Alps, mid January. Snowed in.
intro: Pine Ridge Lodge. An avalanche buried the only road, and nobody can get in or out. At 10:40 pm Margaret Ashdown, the owner of the lodge, is found dead in the study. One of the four people left here did it.
public_facts: An avalanche buried the only road at about 8:00 pm. Nobody could come or go after that.
The fondue supper ended at about 9:30 pm.
Margaret Ashdown, 63, the owner of the lodge, went to the study at about 9:45 pm.
Margaret Ashdown was found dead in the study at 10:40 pm by Henry Ashdown. She had been struck on the head.
The people here that night were: Henry Ashdown (Margaret's husband), Rosa Finch (ski technician), Clara Voss (a visitor), Victor Lang (lodge bookkeeper).

solution.motive: Victor Lang had been skimming the ski hire takings and hiding it in a second cash book. Margaret found the second cash book and was going to call the police in the morning.
solution.method: At about 10:05 pm Victor Lang went to the study and argued with Margaret, then struck her with a bronze stag. He took the second cash book to the drying room and pushed it into the stove.

motives.text: To stop Margaret exposing something they had done
To get control of Pine Ridge Lodge
Revenge for something Margaret did that day

evidence.name: Records room receipt tally
evidence.description: Victor Lang's receipt tally from the records room. The last entry is timed 9:40 pm. The job is not finished.

evidence.name: Card room score pad
evidence.description: A score pad in two hands with sums of money owed. It puts Henry Ashdown in the card room from 10:00 pm to 10:22 pm.

evidence.name: Charred cash book
evidence.description: What is left of the second cash book, found in the drying room. Parts of it can still be read.

evidence.name: Victor's cardigan
evidence.description: Victor Lang's cardigan, left in the boot room. There is grey ash on it.

evidence.name: Demotion notice
evidence.description: A signed notice moving the ski technician down to junior pay. It is dated today and names Rosa Finch.

evidence.name: Hotel chain letter
evidence.description: A letter from a hotel chain asking for a private report on the lodge. It names Clara Voss.

henry_ashdown.name: Henry Ashdown
henry_ashdown.role: Margaret Ashdown's husband. He put up half the money for the lodge.
story_they_tell: After the fondue supper I was reading in bed.
Later I went to look for Margaret. I found Margaret dead in the study at 10:40 pm and I screamed.
Victor Lang was the first to reach me, within a minute.
Everything was perfectly fine between me and Margaret.
shares_freely: Margaret had been shut in the study every evening this week, in a foul mood.
This afternoon I heard Margaret shouting at Rosa Finch. I do not know what it was about.
henry_ashdown.under_pressure: Go cold and formal. Repeat your account. Say you cannot believe anyone here would do this.

stages.label: Shaken
admits: I was not reading in bed. From 10:00 pm to about 10:22 pm I was in the card room, playing cards for money with the barman.
I had promised her I would stop gambling. I lied because it makes me look guilty.
At 10:40 pm I went to the study and found Margaret dead.
When Victor Lang reached me, he was not wearing his cardigan, which is unusual.

hidden_truth.secret: Was in the card room, playing cards for money with the barman. I had promised her I would stop gambling.
what_really_happened: 10:00 pm to 10:22 pm: in the card room, playing cards for money with the barman.
giveaway_phrases: playing cards for money with the barman
I had promised her I would stop gambling

rosa_finch.name: Rosa Finch
rosa_finch.role: Ski technician. She repairs and waxes the hire skis.
story_they_tell: After the fondue supper I was in the ski workshop, waxing the hire skis. I stayed there until I heard the scream at 10:40 pm.
I saw nobody after about 9:30 pm.
Things between me and Margaret were fine, same as always.
shares_freely: Clara Voss has been asking the people here odd questions.
Margaret had been in a bad temper all week.
rosa_finch.under_pressure: Get irritated and defensive. Repeat your account. Say the detective should look at Clara Voss, who has been asking a lot of questions.

stages.label: Cornered
admits: Margaret demoted me this afternoon. I hid it because it makes me look guilty.
I was not in the ski workshop the whole time. From about 10:10 pm to 10:25 pm I was outside the workshop side door, clearing snow from the step.
At about 10:20 pm I saw Victor Lang coming out of the drying room, with grey ash on his cardigan. He did not see me.
The drying room is nowhere near the records room.

hidden_truth.secret: Margaret demoted them today, and they were outside the workshop side door at the time of the murder.
what_really_happened: 10:10 pm to 10:25 pm: outside the workshop side door, clearing snow from the step.
10:20 pm: saw Victor Lang leave the drying room.

clara_voss.name: Clara Voss
clara_voss.role: A visitor. Says they are a wildlife photographer. She arrived a few days ago.
story_they_tell: I am a wildlife photographer. I am here to photograph the winter birds.
After the fondue supper I stayed with the others until about 10:05 pm, then I went to my own quarters.
I was in my quarters when I heard the scream at 10:40 pm, and I came out.
shares_freely: At about 10:05 pm, on my way to my quarters, I passed the study and heard two people arguing inside. One was Margaret, and she was the loud one. The other voice was low and controlled. I could not tell who it was.
I heard Margaret say something like 'two years' and 'in the morning'.
Margaret and Henry Ashdown did not seem to get on.
clara_voss.under_pressure: Stay charming and a little amused. Repeat your account. Remark that Margaret and Henry Ashdown did not seem to get on.

stages.label: Exposed
admits: I am not a wildlife photographer. I am a scout for a hotel chain, and I want to buy the lodge and turn it into a resort.
Two days ago I told Margaret what I wanted, and she refused angrily and told me to leave. I stayed on anyway.
From what I have seen this week, something is badly wrong with how this place is run, and I think Margaret had just found out.

hidden_truth.secret: Is really a scout for a hotel chain and wants to buy the lodge and turn it into a resort.
what_really_happened: 10:05 pm: passed the study and heard the argument, then went to their quarters.
giveaway_phrases: a scout for a hotel chain
buy the lodge and turn it into a resort

victor_lang.name: Victor Lang
victor_lang.role: Lodge bookkeeper. He has kept the lodge's books for eight years.
victor_lang.speaking_style: Measured and exact, a little dry.
story_they_tell: After the fondue supper I went to the records room. I was balancing the week's receipts.
I was in the records room from about 9:30 pm until about 10:30 pm. I was alone and saw nobody.
I came when I heard the scream at 10:40 pm, and found Henry Ashdown at the door of the study.
I did not go near the study tonight until the scream.
I got on well with Margaret. Nothing was wrong between us.
shares_freely: Margaret told me this afternoon that she had demoted Rosa Finch, who took it badly.
Clara Voss has asked a lot of questions about this place.
victor_lang.under_pressure: Stay calm and polite. Repeat your account. Suggest, as if reluctantly, that the detective should look at Rosa Finch.

stages.label: Guarded
admits: The job was not finished. I stopped at about 9:40 pm and spent the rest of the time filing old invoices.
I still say I never left the records room.

stages.label: Rattled
admits: I was not in the records room the whole time. At about 10:10 pm I went to the drying room, only to feed the stove before bed, and I got grey ash on my cardigan there.
I did not mention it before because it did not seem important.
I know nothing about any second cash book, and I still say I never went to the study.

stages.label: Broken
admits: I have been skimming the ski hire takings and hiding it in a second cash book for two years.
Margaret found the second cash book this afternoon and was going to call the police in the morning.
At about 10:05 pm I went to the study to beg for more time. We argued, and at about 10:10 pm I struck Margaret with a bronze stag.
Then I took the second cash book to the drying room and pushed it into the stove. That is how I got grey ash on my cardigan.

hidden_truth.secret: Killed Margaret Ashdown. Had been skimming the ski hire takings and hiding it in a second cash book.
what_really_happened: 10:05 pm: went to the study and argued with Margaret.
10:10 pm: struck Margaret with a bronze stag.
10:12 pm: took the second cash book to the drying room and pushed it into the stove.
10:20 pm: left the drying room and was seen by Rosa Finch.
giveaway_phrases: skimming the ski hire takings and hiding it in a second cash book
